author: Jed Dart
text:
Totally impressed with Vineyard Septic. Called Todd, he scheduled me in two days and had a great price. Blake came out and was very polite and explained the entire process to me and answered all my questions. He gave me good maintenance advice to keep our system from having major problems in the future.
I would highly recommend this company from my own experience

author: Tori Miller
text: Septic One was honest, professional and prompt. We had our septic tank "pumped" by a different company 6m ago. Late last night our toilets couldn't flush and found that our clean out had standing water. Called first thing in the morning, Blake and Todd came out same day to investigate. Turns out the last company only pumped the second tank! These guys took the time to find the first tank and thoroughly cleaned it while pumping both tanks. Will be recommending and using them again!

author: Alex and Alissa Arbuckle
text: While we had an initial miscommunication regarding scheduling, Todd the owner made it right and got our septic service completed professionally and in a timely manner. The driver, Blake, who came out to our house, was extremely knowledgeable and did an outstanding job. I will use Septic One again the next time we require septic service.

author: YESHUA Garden
text: Blake and Todd were wonderful. Wired in my pump. We discussed the whole process of an aerobic system. They were very efficient even in this cold they came out to provide excellent service. Highly recommend

author: Scott Cochran
text: This company is outstanding.  Talked to the owner and he was very helpful in determining the solution to my issue.  Blake showed up on time and was also very helpful in educating me about my system.  A polite, respectful, hard-working young man.   If you have septic issues or just want your tanks pumped I would highly recommend this outfit.
